title: Mail Configuration
description: SMTP and email delivery settings stored under System/Mail

sections.title: SMTP Server
sections.description: Host, port, protocol, and sender defaults

fields.name: hostName
fields.label: Host Name
fields.description: Address of the SMTP server.

fields.name: port
fields.label: Port
fields.description: Connection port. 587 is common for STARTTLS; 465 for implicit SSL.

fields.name: from
fields.label: From Address
fields.description: Default sender address shown in the From field.

fields.name: mailProtocol
fields.label: Mail Protocol
fields.description: Transport protocol for outbound mail.

fields.name: systemadmin
fields.label: System Admin Recipient
fields.description: Default recipient for system schedule emails when email.to is empty.

fields.name: isAuthenticated
fields.label: Authenticated
fields.description: When yes, SMTP login with username/password is required.

fields.name: user
fields.label: Username
fields.description: SMTP account used to log in.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.description: Password or app password for the SMTP user.

fields.name: isSSLEnabled
fields.label: SSL Enabled
fields.description: Implicit SSL (typically port 465).

fields.name: sslProtocols
fields.label: SSL Protocols
fields.description: Preferred TLS protocol version.

fields.name: ttlsEnabled
fields.label: STARTTLS Enabled
fields.description: Upgrade the connection with STARTTLS (common on port 587).

fields.name: ttlsRequired
fields.label: STARTTLS Required
fields.description: Fail if the server does not support a secure TLS upgrade.

fields.name: subject
fields.label: Subject Prefix
fields.description: Default subject prefix for generated emails.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body Notice
fields.description: Default body notice included in generated emails.

fields.name: minIdle
fields.label: Min Idle
fields.description: Minimum idle connections kept in the pool.

fields.name: maxIdle
fields.label: Max Idle
fields.description: Maximum idle connections retained.

fields.name: maxTotal
fields.label: Max Total
fields.description: Absolute limit of simultaneous SMTP connections.

fields.name: maxWaitMillis
fields.label: Max Wait (ms)
fields.description: How long to wait for a pooled connection.

fields.name: setTestOnBorrow
fields.label: Test On Borrow
fields.description: Validate the SMTP connection before lending it from the pool.

fields.name: keepAlive
fields.label: Keep Alive
fields.description: Keep the socket open between transmissions.

fields.name: debug
fields.label: Debug
fields.description: Print the SMTP handshake to the console.
